dos: These conventions apply to a repository that ships no application or library runtime code. Validation scripts, tests, and test fixtures used only to validate the documentation repository are allowed.
donts: Documentation-only repositories must not omit applicable documentation requirements.

dos: Every documentation-only repository must extend the general AGENTS.md requirements with applicable documentation guidance.
donts: A documentation-only repository must not omit AGENTS.md.

dos: After the seven general AGENTS.md headings, add a ## Documentation section. Document documentation scope, indexes, link validation, and documentation-only limits.
donts: AGENTS.md must not allow implementation code or undocumented canonical policy in a documentation-only repository.

dos: Documentation-only repositories use root README.md as their documentation entry point and specs/README.md to index structured records. Root README.md must link specs/README.md; a separate docs/ subfolder or docs/README.md is not required.
donts: Documentation-only repositories must not leave required documentation surfaces undiscoverable or introduce implementation code as canonical policy.

dos: Documentation-only README.md must add Scope, Navigation, Contribution, and Documentation validation, in that order, for repository scope, documentation sources, indexes, contribution/setup requirements, and link/document validation. Place these headings in the profile extension area defined by general.json and include them in the Table of Contents.

Human or AI review must identify the repository's documentation surfaces and confirm that the relevant indexes link to each one. The deterministic link check validates that declared links resolve; it does not claim that the indexes are complete.
donts: Documentation-only README.md must not present implementation code, operational procedures, or duplicated canonical content.

dos: Deterministic validation must verify that every repository-relative Markdown link and structured-document path resolves to an existing target, and that every Markdown fragment resolves. External links are checked for valid URL form only; human or AI review confirms their availability and intended target.
donts: Do not leave a documented path or embedded reference pointing to a missing target.
